lines.trans: Kitchen, I ask everyone to pay attention!
At first glance, these are ordinary fish trimmings.
But if you look at them more closely...
Now this is our new dish of the day.
These are exquisite homemade trout sausages.
Those trimmings used to be my own dish of the day.
Now there is no way to sneak them home from the kitchen.
Comrade Chef, taste this dish right here.
I also prepared a dish of the day out of scraps.
Well done, Fedya, let's see what is here.
Here is a side dish of fresh potato peels.
I named this dish Provençal slops.

examples.text: Я только посмотрел.
examples.trans: I only had a look.

examples.text: А можно я пойду посмотрю?
examples.trans: Can I go and have a look?

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian personal or demonstrative pronoun meaning 'what, that', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.text: Значит, тебе нужно там что-то менять.
examples.trans: Then you need to change something there.

examples.text: Баринова, что ли? Он мне даром не нужен.
examples.trans: Barinov, you mean? I do not need him even for free.

examples.text: Ну, это смотря что именно варить.
examples.trans: Well, that depends on what exactly you cook.

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian conversational adverb meaning 'here', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.text: Тут написано, следующую подсказку кормит Сеня.
examples.trans: It says here that Senya feeds the next clue.

examples.text: Молодец, Федя, давай посмотрим, что тут.
examples.trans: Well done, Fedya, let's see what is here.

examples.text: Тут гарнир из свежих картофельных очистков.
examples.trans: Here is a side dish of fresh potato peels.

meanings.note: Common masculine noun meaning 'side dish' in everyday Russian.

examples.text: Тут гарнир из свежих картофельных очистков.
examples.trans: Here is a side dish of fresh potato peels.

examples.text: Повар приготовил овощной гарнир.
examples.trans: The cook prepared a vegetable side dish.

examples.text: Приготовь специальный соус и красивый гарнир.
examples.trans: Prepare a special sauce and a beautiful side dish.

meanings.note: Prefix 'с-' ('together' or 'down from') marks convergence or completion (stem 'вежий'). Agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies ('fresh').

examples.text: Сейчас свежую форель привезли, пойду принимать.
examples.trans: Fresh trout was just delivered, I am going to receive it.

examples.text: Если у вас есть свежие идеи, предлагайте.
examples.trans: If you have fresh ideas, suggest them.

examples.text: Есть свежие идеи — предлагайте.
examples.trans: If you have fresh ideas, suggest them.

meanings.note: Adjective formed with the common Slavic suffix '-н-' from a noun/verb root. Agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies ('potato').

examples.text: Тут гарнир из свежих картофельных очистков.
examples.trans: Here is a side dish of fresh potato peels.

examples.text: Шеф говорит, что это очень картофельный выбор.
examples.trans: The chef says that this is a very potato choice.

meanings.note: Common masculine noun meaning 'peelings' in everyday Russian.

examples.text: Тут гарнир из свежих картофельных очистков.
examples.trans: Here is a side dish of fresh potato peels.

examples.text: На кухне отеля всегда есть очистки.
examples.trans: In the hotel kitchen there is always peelings.

meanings.note: Prefix 'на-' marks surface contact, accumulation, or completing a quantity (stem 'звать'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'called', paired with 'называть'.

examples.text: Я назвал это блюдо прованские помои.
examples.trans: I named this dish Provençal slops.

examples.text: Тут стоит название нашего ресторана и дата.
examples.trans: The name of our restaurant and today's date are here.

examples.text: Ты назвал меня плохим словом.
examples.trans: You called me a bad word.

meanings.note: Prefix 'про-' indicates movement through, completion, or missing the mark (stem 'ванский'). Relational adjective formed with the Slavic suffix '-ский' ('pertaining to'). Agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies ('Provençal').

examples.text: Я назвал это блюдо прованские помои.
examples.trans: I named this dish Provençal slops.

examples.text: Шеф говорит, что это очень прованский выбор.
examples.trans: The chef says that this is a very Provençal choice.

meanings.note: Common masculine noun meaning 'slops' in everyday Russian.

examples.text: Помнишь, как мы с тобой в окопах были?
examples.trans: Remember how you and I were in the trenches together?

examples.text: Я назвал это блюдо прованские помои.
examples.trans: I named this dish Provençal slops.

examples.text: Я просто так чужие лица не запоминаю.
examples.trans: I do not remember strangers' faces for no reason.
